name: Oracle Bone Inscriptions (Anyang)
notes: Late Shang divination records, predominantly from Yinxu near Anyang. Roughly 4,500 distinct graphs identified; per a 2016 National Museum of Chinese Writing decipherment-reward program (China Daily, 28 Oct 2016), the meanings of over 3,000 remain unresolved — report as a range (roughly 30-40% reliably deciphered, not a single point figure, since sources diverge). Only three scholars had successfully claimed the reward as of 2016.
